name: Lincoln Park Farmers Market
specialty: Organic Vegetables, Heirloom Tomatoes, Artisan Goat Cheese
description: A bustling community market nestled in historic Lincoln Park featuring generational growers, fresh berries, and certified biodynamic vegetables.

name: Green City Market
specialty: Orchard Fruits, Sweet Berries, Pastured Eggs & Dairy
description: Chicago's premier certified sustainable farmers market supporting regional family farmers and educating consumers on sustainable agriculture.

name: Logan Square Farmers Market
specialty: Artisan Sourdough Bakery, Raw Wildflower Honey & Microgreens
description: Set along the historic Logan Boulevard, this vibrant Sunday open-air market hosts local beekeepers, craft sourdough bakers, and organic root vegetable stalls.

name: Wicker Park Farmers Market
specialty: Small-batch Jams, Sweet Strawberries & Fresh Herbs
description: Surrounded by lush park gardens, Wicker Park market offers fresh berries, botanical teas, farmstead flowers, and handcrafted condiments.

name: Daley Plaza Farmers Market
specialty: Cold-pressed Sunflower Oils, Stone Fruit & Fresh Cider
description: The longest-running farmers market in Chicago, situated right beneath the Picasso sculpture in downtown Loop.

name: Pilsen Community Market
specialty: Heirloom Peppers, Mexican Street Corn & Artisan Baguettes
description: A vibrant multicultural neighborhood market celebrating local urban farmers, heirloom hot peppers, and traditional artisanal pastries.
